prBodyNotes: Alchemy bump checklist: (a) telemetry opt-out still honoured (`ALCHEMY_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1` in the `alchemy` script); (b) no `TelemetryLive` in the state-store Worker; (c) the Secrets Store and Flagship pricing pages re-read; (d) the `action.yml` diff between the old and new pinned commits of Alchemy's Action read. A PR with the `alchemy-upgrade` label runs checks only, no preview; its `prod` plan probe says whether merging upgrades the state store one way.

Type-check engine re-check (C29h): T1, `npm view tsrs dist-tags.latest` has no prerelease suffix and targets the `typescript` version this repository pins; T2, this PR's `@effect/tsgo` is at least 3 days old (the release age above), lists that tsrs in its Supported Package Versions and no longer marks `--tsrs-lint` experimental. If both hold, open the engine-swap issue: it runs on the Linux CI runner and diffs the full `vp check` diagnostic set on the real tree under both engines. Whatever the result, the swap keeps `"diagnostics": false` in the Effect language-service plugin entry of `tsconfig.json` unless `Effect-TS/tsgo#1025` is closed.
